name: baalda-os
description: Turn a Baalda vault into an AI-operated second brain. Three skills: /baalda-setup bootstraps the OS structure and runs onboarding, /baalda-optimizer runs a 9-framework audit that checkpoints first and keeps every note's doc_id intact, and /baalda-guide answers any question about Baalda's features, file formats, sync, sharing and AI in plain language. Setup and optimizer are Baalda-native forks of the Obsidian plugin's os-setup and os-optimizer.
